reviews.boundary_analysis: Repeat-until-green is bounded by genuine input need and explicit stop/reassess conditions; unrelated new failures must be reverted/corrected and knowingly worse state is forbidden. Those independent limits are prior-covered, not an obligation to repeat failed guesses indefinitely.

Distinct report schemas include four security layer statuses, literal NEEDS VERIFICATION, eight confirmed-finding fields, open Decision Requests and actual verification statuses. Per-workflow package/settings/persistence/Git fields already have specific union records; no fresh reporting atom found.

Agent disallows Write/Edit/NotebookEdit but shell/MultiEdit coverage is not established; policy still forbids edits. Workflow permits edits when explicitly asked while fixed delegate does not redefine criteria. This tension plus thin-delegate warning is already registered.

Explicit ordered priorities, no tooling-owned formatting findings, plausible execution-path gate, context before diagnostic promotion and four severity definitions are covered. Full security scan is request/sensitivity/concrete-finding gated, not demanded for every review.
No filler praise, no invented exploitability and no unadopted architecture-pattern findings independently narrow output. Union explicitly represents these beyond generic no-invented-findings wording.

Read complete relevant output, group causes, inspect actual configuration, compare old/new failure sets and use verified upgrade documentation. These sequential diagnostic requirements are explicit prior claims, not inferred from general root-cause-first language.

Reproduce narrowest failure with real repository commands, compare the same failing check and broaden only after resolution. Stop/reassess on stalled or growing failures and classify test-versus-production contract before changing it. Already registered.

Understanding diagnostics precedes suppression/report changes; changed expectations require an actually requested behavior change. CI cannot ignore required-check exit codes or continue-on-error. Strong-assertion/no-inconvenient-test-deletion conditions are explicit prior-covered atoms.
